dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit jagged, high-intensity white perimeters (approx. 5-15 pixels in width) with a sharp step-gradient transition to low-intensity dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of solid-intensity white pixels are present along the upper dorsal ridge and the distal junction near the flipper, appearing as asymmetrical blobs without interior gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal rings form an irregular convex polygon, while the three highest intensity blobs at the posterior base form a roughly isosceles triangle.
